summary.text: A linear equation can be put in the form a₁x₁ + … + aₙₓₙ + b = 0, with variables x₁, …, xₙ, coefficients a₁, …, aₙ and constant term b.
With two variables its solutions form a straight line in the plane, which is where the word linear comes from.
With one variable it has exactly one solution, provided that a₁ ≠ 0.

facts.label: One variable
facts.value: Exactly one solution, provided that a₁ ≠ 0

facts.label: Two variables
facts.value: Solutions form a line in the plane

facts.label: Many variables
facts.value: Solutions form a hyperplane of dimension n − 1

facts.label: Why it matters
facts.value: Non-linear systems are often well approximated by linear equations

facts.label: Zero y-coefficient
facts.value: The line is vertical, not a function of x

items.prompt: You plot every pair (x, y) that satisfies a linear equation in two variables. What shape do the points make?
items.explain: The solutions of a linear equation in two variables form a line.

items.prompt: Why does the name linear equation fit?

options.label: Its solutions in two variables form a line
It always passes through the origin
It can be solved in a single step

items.explain: The name comes from the correspondence between lines and equations whose solutions form a line.

items.prompt: An equation has one unknown with a coefficient that is not zero, such as twice the unknown equals 8. How many solutions does it have?
items.explain: With just one variable there is exactly one solution, provided that a₁ ≠ 0.

items.prompt: In a two-variable linear equation ax + by + c = 0, what does the line look like when b is 0?
items.explain: If b = 0 the line is vertical, and it is not the graph of a function of x; a horizontal line needs a = 0.

items.prompt: An engineer must model a curvy, non-linear system. Why might linear equations still be useful?

options.label: Curvy systems are always exactly linear
Non-linear systems are often well approximated by linear ones

items.explain: Linear equations show up often in physics and engineering partly because non-linear systems are often well approximated by them.

items.prompt: A linear equation uses 4 variables, so its solutions live in 4-dimensional space. How many dimensions does its solution set have?
items.explain: The solutions of a linear equation in n variables form a hyperplane of dimension n − 1.
